domains.name: Storefront UI kit, Bridge soft look, a11y

exploratoryCharters.mission: Discover what breaks when the Site Builder storefront port, custom section types, "Preview as" and the MCP tools meet in one author session; no Frontend suite exists (GAP-24) and 123/123b see only the designer.
candidateScenarios: A page with a custom section type is designed, published and viewed on the storefront in light and dark, then edited again (GAP-24, GAP-27)
"Preview as" a customer, then reload and open a second tab: who the storefront renders (GAP-23)
An agent creates a page through the MCP tools, the designer opens and publishes it, injected HTML in a text block is checked on preview and live (GAP-25, GAP-26)

exploratoryCharters.mission: Discover seams between the new Dashboard Editor, module-error notices, the profile blade and the admin flag guard, which nine tickets changed at once; the editor has no suite (GAP-34).
candidateScenarios: A dashboard widget rule for everyone and one per role, a user layout saved on the server, then the same user on a second browser (GAP-34)
A module that failed to load: the notice in the shell and the Errors filter in the Angular list agree (GAP-35)
The profile blade after a regional format and time zone change, then dates in lists, then login on behalf as a non-admin (GAP-36)

exploratoryCharters.mission: Discover what breaks along one subscriber journey that eight tickets and one large PR changed: product page, cart line, account, order history and the emails; 124, 050p and 125 each assert one link.
candidateScenarios: Subscribe on the product page, change the frequency on the cart line, turn it off, turn it on again, check the cart and the account list (GAP-08, GAP-11)
Pause then skip then cancel a delivery from the delivery settings menu at a short viewport and in a long locale (GAP-10, GAP-12)
Order placed with a subscription line: order history mark, the new emails and the how-it-works page in a second language (GAP-09, GAP-11, GAP-13)

exploratoryCharters.mission: Discover seams between store authentication types, single-use OTP, MFA with an unconfirmed email and the Sign-in log filter; 104, 105, 111 and 114b each hold one method. OTP and MFA toggles are env-wide: run it when no wave is active and restore the settings.
candidateScenarios: OTP offered by store setting, code used once then replayed, the Sign-in log shows both rows and its Type filter finds them (GAP-05, GAP-06, GAP-07)
Email changed on the account, confirmation reset, MFA required: where the sign-in code goes (GAP-04)
Passkey sign-in on an OTP store, then OTP on an MFA store, ending on the right page each time (GAP-06)

exploratoryCharters.mission: Discover what breaks where the binder rewrite, the empty-mapping fix and the server-side compare list meet on the browse path; 050a, 004, 098 and 050q each assert one.
candidateScenarios: Product types side by side (simple, variation, configurable) on listing, PDP and compare: same fields after the binder change (GAP-14)
A guest compare list, sign-in, organization switch, then the same list from a second browser (BL-CAT-014, BL-CAT-015)
Search, reindex and search again with facets and sort, watching for an empty result that should not be (GAP-15)
